from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInventoryRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single financial record extracted from one company's report regarding inventory."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    inventory_value: float | None = Field(description="The value of '存货' (Inventory) reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the financial report, e.g. CNY or Yuan")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the document, e.g. Q1 2024")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    inventory_records: list[CompanyInventoryRecord]
